milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange wall banner is at command-origin (-1, 2, 5). Player spawns at (0, 1, 8), so spawn-relative offset is (-1, 1, -3). Distance from spawn is ~3.3 blocks. max_distance=5 gives comfortable margin for the player to approach and face the banner without requiring pixel-perfect positioning.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The iron door is at command-origin (0, 1, -1), which is spawn-relative (0, 0, -9). Player must enter the building through the entrance and navigate 9 blocks north through the main hall. max_distance=5 requires being well inside the building near the dividing wall.

Uses inventory_has because redstone_block always drops itself when mined with any pickaxe. The 2-high redstone barrier at (-1, 0, -3) and (-1, 1, -3) physically walls off the left wing passage. Mining either block places it in inventory and creates a passable gap.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gray bed foot is at command-origin (-3, 0, -6), which is spawn-relative (-3, -1, -14). Player must pass through the mined redstone barrier to reach the left wing bedroom. max_distance=5 requires being in the bedroom area.

Uses inventory_has because the scene provides a Silk Touch iron pickaxe, which causes packed_ice to drop itself. Without Silk Touch, packed_ice drops nothing. Blocks are deeper in the left wing at (-4, 0, -10), (-5, 0, -10), (-4, 1, -10).

Uses inventory_has because cobblestone drops itself when mined with any pickaxe. The full-width cobblestone blockade at z=-5 (x=1 to x=6, y=0 to y=2) spans the entire right wing corridor width, forcing the player to mine at least one block to pass through.

Uses inventory_has because mossy_cobblestone_wall drops itself when mined with any pickaxe. The full-width barrier at z=-8 (x=1 to x=6, y=0 to y=2) must be breached after clearing the cobblestone blockade to reach the final chamber.

Uses inventory_has because chiseled_red_sandstone drops itself when mined with any pickaxe. The 6 blocks in the final chamber at z=-11/-12 are only reachable after clearing both the cobblestone and mossy cobblestone wall barriers in sequence.
